items.q: 全部销售订单的总金额是多少万元?

A.sql: SELECT SUM(sales_amount) / 10000.0 AS total_amount_wan FROM DWS_ORG_PERFORMANCE_DAILY

C.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) / 10000.0 AS total_wan FROM fact_sales_order

items.q: 2025年3月一共有多少笔销售订单?

A.sql: SELECT SUM(order_count) FROM DWS_IN_SALES_DAILY WHERE date >= '2025-03-01' AND date <= '2025-03-31'

B.sql: SELECT SUM(order_count) AS total_order_count FROM DWS_IN_SALES_DAILY WHERE date >= '2025-03-01' AND date <= '2025-03-31'

C.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM fact_sales_order WHERE order_date >= '2025-03-01' AND order_date <= '2025-03-31'

items.q: 全部生产产出的总产量是多少?

A.sql: SELECT SUM(actual_quantity) AS total_actual_quantity FROM DWS_PRODUCTION_DAILY

C.sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total_output_qty FROM fact_production_output

items.q: 系统里一共有多少台设备?

A.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT equipment_id) AS equipment_count FROM dim_equipment

items.q: 平均每笔销售订单的实际毛利是多少?

A.sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(gross_profit_actual) FROM DWS_ORG_PERFORMANCE_DAILY) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(order_count) FROM DWS_IN_SALES_DAILY) AS avg_gross_profit_actual_per_order

C.sql: SELECT AVG(gross_profit_actual) AS avg_gross_profit_actual FROM fact_sales_order

items.q: 一共有多少条退货记录?

C.sql: SELECT count(*) AS return_count FROM fact_return

items.q: 按生产产出明细记录累计,产量最高的产线叫什么名字?

A.sql: SELECT dim_line_id FROM DWS_PRODUCTION_DAILY GROUP BY dim_line_id ORDER BY SUM(actual_quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

B.sql: SELECT '数据库中不存在生产产出明细记录或产量字段,无法回答该问题' AS note
B.value: 数据库中不存在生产产出明细记录或产量字段,无法回答该问题

C.sql: SELECT dpl.line_name FROM fact_production_output fpo JOIN fact_production_order fpord ON fpo.order_id = fpord.order_id JOIN dim_production_line dpl ON fpord.line_id = dpl.line_id GROUP BY dpl.line_id, dpl.line_name ORDER BY SUM(fpo.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

items.q: 以销售订单明细为准,2025年的月均销售收入是多少万元?

A.sql: SELECT SUM(sales_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT strftime('%Y-%m', date)) / 10000.0 AS avg_monthly_sales_revenue_wan FROM DWS_ORG_PERFORMANCE_DAILY WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '2025'

B.sql: SELECT NULL AS monthly_avg_sales_revenue_wan /* 无销售收入列:所列各表(售后/资金/设备/财务/接单)均无销售订单明细的收入金额字段,无法计算 */

C.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date)) / 10000.0 AS monthly_avg_revenue_wan FROM fact_sales_order WHERE strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2025'
